ig-DW2FRgojpMa.name: Retro PS1 Low-Poly Nightscape
ig-DW2FRgojpMa.tagline: Late-90s 3D video game aesthetic suited for liminal late-night urban scenes.

files.source.mp4: Original IG reel — 1080x1920, 12.5s. Use frames/ for references; rarely need to pass the full mp4.
files.frames/frame_01..08.jpg: 8 representative frames extracted at ~1.5s intervals. Pass 3-5 of these as reference_images per clip.
files.style.json: Gemini structured style description. The `prompt_template` field is the load-bearing line — paste verbatim into prompts. The `what_to_avoid` list is non-decorative; strip those terms from your prompt.

best_used_for: Retro-styled news scenes (single anchor, low-poly desk + monitor wall)
Late-night urban establishing shots (storefronts, signage, payphones)
iconic_motifs_in_source: Floating game-pickup items with glowing auras

notes: Style packs are pulled, not committed. The local pull location (runs/style-packs/) is gitignored.
Path references in docs/style-rip/examples/*.json assume the pack is pulled to runs/style-packs/<slug>/.

To add a new style pack: follow the workflow in docs/style-rip/README.md, then push with `python scripts/asset_pack_push.py runs/style-packs/<slug> <slug> --prefix style-packs`, then add an entry to this manifest.
